title: [BUG] Cannot import xml from previous version
author: DaanSelen
body_snippet:
Hello mRemoteNG,

I just updated my 3702 to the latest release but its unable to use my confCons.xml at all.
Also saving the connection profile does not work and does not safe any file.

comments.author: cremenescu
comments.snippet:
This looks like #3580. Nightly builds made between 30 September and 9 November ask for a "Profile password" at startup. Entering a password creates a new, empty profile database, and from then on connections are loaded from it and saved to it instead of confCons.xml. Your confCons.xml itself is not changed.

In NB 3702, click Cancel at the "Profile password" prompt: mRemoteNG then loads confCons.xml as before and saves to it again. Since 9 November (#3648, #3653) the prompt no longer appears unl...
